item: Foreign ownership limit on DSE-listed equities
finding_as_stated_by_source: The 60% aggregate foreign-holding cap of the Capital Markets and Securities (Foreign Investors) Regulations, 2003 was revoked by the 2014 Regulations (G.N. No. 338, reported dated 19 Sep 2014); a companion BoT amendment to the Foreign Exchange (Listed Securities) Regulations (G.N. No. 132, gazetted 2 May 2014) removed the limit on the foreign-exchange side. No later reinstatement was found in this search.
source_title: UNCTAD Investment Policy Monitor: Tanzania removed foreign ownership restrictions in the stock market
